style-message.text: I'm Mia. I usually go for a casual look. I love my denim jacket and faded jeans. I don't like being the centre of attention. My friends say I'm easy-going because I never lose my temper.

speaking-model.text: This is my friend. She has wavy hair. She usually wears a denim jacket and ankle boots. She goes for a casual look. She's easy-going and down-to-earth. She feels comfortable in her own skin.
